bias.en: Rebound · above the 5-day and July lows, under the 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 站上 5 日均线和 7 月低点，仍低于 200 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 3.5% on Nov 9 to $388.62, trading between $380.33 and $394.39. It is above the falling 5-day ($383.5) and below the falling 10-day ($403.1), 30-day ($430.5) and 100-day ($427.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($401.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($421.35), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 台积电 11月9日上涨 3.5%，收于 $388.62，盘中区间 $380.33–394.39。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$383.5）上方，下行的 10 日（$403.1）、30 日（$430.5）和 100 日均线（$427.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$401.8）下方。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$421.35），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close cleared the $380.7–382.2 and $385.5–388.8 resistances (Nov 6 high, Jul 28 low, 5-day, July lows), now support. Resistance is $394.4 (Nov 9 high), then $398.3–403.1 (Nov 2 low, 200 and 10-day) and $421.4 (SAR). Support is $380.3–383.5 (Nov 9 low, Jul 28 low, 5-day), then $372.7 (Jul 29 low) and $359.2–368. A close above $394.4 would target $398–403; below $380.3, $372.7.
